page.notes: Lines start with printed » marks, copied as printed. The first line continues from the previous page. The speaker letters D., Q. and R. are printed in the text and kept inline. The printed line breaks do not clearly show whether "mea." and "Q." begin new paragraphs, so the passage is kept as one paragraph. The first word is printed in lowercase "trouersia" and is kept as printed. The running head title is heavy decorative type and is unreadable. Possible printing errors: "faciedi", "intestatus" and "cessit" are printed as shown. The word "cessit" and "intestatus" appear with a long s as printed and are kept. The word "testatus" is printed as shown.
